usb.title: USB Content Export
usb.subtitle: Plug a USB stick in, pick playlists, and we’ll sign + download the bundle straight to it.
usb.ingestToggleHint: When disabled, paired screens will reject any USB bundle — even signed ones. Disabling does not invalidate existing keys; you can re-enable later without losing them.
usb.keySetHint: Signing key is set{rotated}. Click to generate a fresh one — the in-app export keeps working either way.
usb.noKeyHint: No signing key yet. Generate one before exporting.
usb.saveKeyNow: Save this key now if you plan to use the standalone CLI.
usb.saveKeyNowDetail: For in-app USB exports you don’t need it — the server signs each bundle automatically. You can generate a new key any time.
usb.fsSupported: Chrome / Edge: we’ll ask you to pick the USB drive, then write every file directly into it.
usb.fsUnsupported: Your browser doesn’t support direct-to-USB writes. We’ll download a .zip you can extract onto the stick.
usb.screenScopeHint: Scoping to a screen embeds its id in the manifest so the player can warn if the stick is for the wrong display.
usb.includeEmergency: Also include the tenant’s emergency playlist (recommended — keeps lockdown content on the player without WiFi)
usb.buildingBundle: Building signed bundle on the server…
usb.wroteComplete: ✓ Wrote {count} assets to USB ({size} MB). Plug the USB into a paired player to ingest.
usb.wroteTruncated: Wrote {count} assets to USB ({size} MB). ⚠ Bundle hit the size cap — some assets were left out.
usb.downloadedBundle: Downloaded bundle ({count} assets, {size} MB). Extract it to your USB root as-is.
usb.newKeyConfirmMessage: Any USB bundle signed with the current key will stop working immediately. Only operators with the new key (or the in-app export flow) can ingest going forward.

usbCard.title: USB Sneakernet Ingest
usbCard.subtitle: Sideload content to paired Android players over USB — for buildings with no WiFi, isolated VLANs, or content updates during a network outage.
usbCard.stateEnabledHint: Players issued a USB key on next pair will accept signed content bundles.
usbCard.stateDisabledHint: Enable to start issuing USB keys to paired players.
usbCard.noKeyYet: No key generated yet — rotate to create one.
usbCard.rotateWarning: Rotating invalidates every previously-signed USB bundle. All operators must use the new key to sign new bundles. Players themselves pick up the new key on their next check-in.
usbCard.howToBuild: How to build a USB bundle →
usbCard.shownOnce: This key is shown ONCE. Copy it now — the dashboard will never show it again.
usbCard.clipboardBlocked: Clipboard blocked by the browser — select the key above and copy it manually.
usbCard.storeHint: Store this in a password manager or your build environment as EDU_USB_KEY. Anyone with this key can sign bundles your players will trust.
usbCard.enableConfirmMessage: This will generate an HMAC signing key for this tenant and let paired Android players accept content sideloaded via USB stick. Operators will need this key to sign bundles.
usbCard.disableConfirmMessage: Paired players will refuse new USB content immediately. Existing on-disk content keeps playing until cleared. The HMAC key is preserved (re-enable to use the same key).
usbCard.rotateConfirmMessage: Bundles signed with the old key will be REJECTED by every player on next ingest attempt. Operators will need the new key to sign future bundles. The new key is shown once.
